svg.text: Six phases · two agents · phase mode shown above each column · categories raised shown below

g.text: page-with-text · consumed by every phase below
soft cap = nudge to close · hard cap = forced
both plans visible to both agents
drafter selected here · used in P3

text.tspan: Every phase consumes the user prompt. Multi-round phases negotiate to an explicit agreement (the green pill). One-shot phases produce in a single turn. Finalize is mechanical assembly.

svg.text: Round caps: soft nudges the agents to close · hard forces termination. P3's drafter is chosen during P2 and may be either agent.
